report: This year, the highest fire count so far and Diwali fell on the same day

inputs.note: Raw captures and scripts in the repository under scripts/reports/lahore-morning-after-diwali/analysis/; draft 6 frozen in analysis/frozen-draft6/

evidence.claim: Fire spots per PKT day, Pakistani and Indian Punjab, all satellites and NOAA-20 only
evidence.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21; Suomi NPP until 2 Nov 2026) and MODIS: 2019-2025 from standard/final processing (SP), 2026 from near real time (NRT); merged into spots by HamariHawa's daily archive (scripts/build-feed.py distinct(): VIIRS detections falling in the same ~0.004 deg (~400 m) grid cell on the same PKT day count once; MODIS near a VIIRS spot dropped); /api/day?d=, fetched 9 Nov 2026
evidence.geography: Punjab (Pakistan), Punjab (India) as assigned by geo.py district/state lookup
evidence.method: summary.states[country|state] = [spots, night, NOAA-20 spots, NOAA-20 night]
evidence.status: reproduced from HamariHawa archive (consistent with own archive; not independently checked against NASA raw rows)

evidence.claim: 8 Nov 2026 was the busiest recorded day of 1 Oct-8 Nov 2026 in the two Punjabs (all satellites 2,859; NOAA-20 931), and also for the whole countries (all satellites 5,419; NOAA-20 1,974) and the northern-plains box (NOAA-20 1,276)
evidence.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21; Suomi NPP until 2 Nov 2026) and MODIS: 2019-2025 from standard/final processing (SP), 2026 from near real time (NRT); merged into spots by HamariHawa's daily archive (scripts/build-feed.py distinct(): VIIRS detections falling in the same ~0.004 deg (~400 m) grid cell on the same PKT day count once; MODIS near a VIIRS spot dropped); /api/day?d=, fetched 9 Nov 2026
evidence.geography: Pakistani + Indian Punjab; whole countries (all Pakistan and India in the archive); northern-plains box

evidence.claim: Busiest recorded Oct-Nov day in the two Punjabs vs Diwali, 2019-2026 (2026 to 8 Nov). Diwali was the busiest day only in 2026, on both series; four historical peak dates differ between the series. Known NOAA-20 data gaps (e.g. 1 Oct 2023: 0 NOAA-20 spots vs 640 all-satellite) are missing data, not zero fires; they do not change these maxima
evidence.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21; Suomi NPP until 2 Nov 2026) and MODIS: 2019-2025 from standard/final processing (SP), 2026 from near real time (NRT); merged into spots by HamariHawa's daily archive (scripts/build-feed.py distinct(): VIIRS detections falling in the same ~0.004 deg (~400 m) grid cell on the same PKT day count once; MODIS near a VIIRS spot dropped); /api/day?d=, fetched 9 Nov 2026
evidence.interval_tz: 1 Oct-30 Nov each year (2026: to 8 Nov), PKT days
evidence.method: max over days; Diwali = main Lakshmi Puja day

evidence.claim: NOAA-20 busiest recorded day, two Punjabs: 2019-2022 range 4,268-6,483; 2025 911 (SP); 2026 to 8 Nov 931 (NRT). 931 vs 911 differs by 20 spots (2.2%) across different processing stages: provisional
evidence.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21; Suomi NPP until 2 Nov 2026) and MODIS: 2019-2025 from standard/final processing (SP), 2026 from near real time (NRT); merged into spots by HamariHawa's daily archive (scripts/build-feed.py distinct(): VIIRS detections falling in the same ~0.004 deg (~400 m) grid cell on the same PKT day count once; MODIS near a VIIRS spot dropped); /api/day?d=, fetched 9 Nov 2026

evidence.claim: Busiest districts on 8 Nov: Jhang (PK) 287, Sangrur 245, Bathinda 213, Firozpur 207, Hafizabad (PK) 193
evidence.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21; Suomi NPP until 2 Nov 2026) and MODIS: 2019-2025 from standard/final processing (SP), 2026 from near real time (NRT); merged into spots by HamariHawa's daily archive (scripts/build-feed.py distinct(): VIIRS detections falling in the same ~0.004 deg (~400 m) grid cell on the same PKT day count once; MODIS near a VIIRS spot dropped); /api/day?d=, fetched 9 Nov 2026

evidence.claim: IQAir Lahore city figure (median of station hourly concentrations): Sun 00-09 200-223; Sun 14:00 137; Sun 21:00 212; Mon 00:00 233, 04:00 313, 09:00 398.5 (AQI 646), 11:00 280, 12:00 185.5, 15:00 97.4; Sun 09:00 219 (AQI 294)

evidence.method: displayed values; city = median per IQAir docs

evidence.claim: 52 Lahore station feeds read; 49 with 9 am values both days; 48 higher Mon; 26 with AQI+ at least twice as high (index ratio, not a concentration ratio); median AQI+ 294 -> 645; 39 above 500; Ravi Road 265 -> 257 (peak 457 in the hour starting 04:00, preceded by 436); above 1,000: Allama Iqbal Town 1,063 (10:00), QIE Indus Plus 1,012 (09:00); hourly station median Sun 19:00-23:00 = 267-292
evidence.source: IQAir station pages linked from the Lahore city page, History > Hourly US AQI+
evidence.interval_tz: hours by start, PKT; captured 16:40-16:42 UTC 9 Nov
evidence.method: per-station comparison of the 09:00 hour Sun vs Mon; medians over stations with data
evidence.status: reproduced from retained re-capture; differs slightly from the first capture (48/48 rose, 29 doubled, median 651, 41 > 500), which was summarised in-browser and not retained

evidence.claim: Multan >600 from 00:00 to 10:00 Mon, peak 700 at 02:00; Faisalabad >500 08:00-13:00, peak 612 at 11:00; Gujranwala peak 298 (Sat night 288); Islamabad max 181
evidence.interval_tz: hours by start, PKT; captured ~17:00 PKT 9 Nov
evidence.status: as displayed; not read station by station

evidence.claim: CAMS series retrieved 9 Nov: Lahore 148.1 at 21:00 Sun, 84.8 at 09:00 Mon; city figure / model 1.5-2.0 Sat 18:00-Sun 08:00; 4.7 at 09:00 Mon
evidence.source: CAMS global via Open-Meteo air-quality API (hourly=pm2_5,us_aqi&past_days=5&timezone=Asia/Karachi), retrieved 9 Nov 2026
evidence.interval_tz: PKT; series as served on 9 Nov (rolling, not the run available 8 Nov)
evidence.method: model value vs IQAir city median: different spatial samples

evidence.claim: Punjab EPD special report (via Dunya News, 8 Nov 16:50 PKT): pollution could reach dangerous levels Sun night-Mon morning, worst until ~10 am Mon; cites Diwali fireworks, winds from Indian Punjab, crop burning, still night air; comparison report promised 10 Nov
evidence.status: attributed to news report; original EPD bulletin not found

evidence.claim: GFS at Lahore: Sat night mean wind 4.6 km/h, mixing 28 m; Sun night 7.3 km/h, 51 m; RH max 37-38%; inversion most hours both nights; wind turned from NW to E at 18:00 PKT Sat
evidence.source: GFS via Open-Meteo forecast API (gfs_seamless), retrieved 9 Nov

evidence.claim: Modelled back-paths to Lahore (arrivals 00/03/06/09 PKT Mon, 10 m and 925 hPa) all approach from the east; with the map's country polygons, the first backward 15-min sample inside India is 3-4.75 h before arrival (9 am 925 hPa: 04:45); midnight-arrival air near Amritsar at 18:00 Sun; 9 am-arrival air 93-115 km E at 18:00, near Tarn Taran at 00:00; spots within 10/20/40 km of the 9 am paths: 22/47/146 (10 m) and 19/42/146 (925 hPa); each 40 km total = 126 IN + 20 PK. Proximity screen on retained detection times, not a count of contributing fires
evidence.source: traj.py, traj_sensitivity.py on GFS winds (data/wind-grid.json: Open-Meteo gfs_seamless, 0.5 deg request grid 28-34N 69-78E, timezone GMT, retrieved 9 Nov)
evidence.method: u/v bilinear in space, linear in time, 15-min steps, horizontal only; fire screen samples every second step (30 min), bounding box derived from R then haversine test (draft 7 had a fixed 0.25/0.3 deg box that truncated the 40 km search); archive keeps one time per merged spot
evidence.status: computed; approximate; 925 hPa is several hundred m above ground and may be decoupled from surface at night

evidence.claim: Faisalabad 9 am-arrival air over Lahore 12:00-18:00 Sun; Multan near-ground air near Pakpattan Sun evening, across Vehari overnight; Multan 925 hPa path from Ganganagar

IQAir Delhi: 30 feeds = 17 attributed to CPCB, 10 to DPCC, 3 private. Private (Luca VV Block C 2,089 at 04:30; TL Safdarjung 1,565; Daniel I Poorvi Marg 1,410) all > 1,000 Sun night, midday 209-222; DPCC > 1,000 Sun night: Vivek Vihar 1,591, Anand Vihar 1,380, Sonia Vihar 1,085; DPCC > 1,000 Sat night: 4 feeds; CPCB night max 192-198; 16 of the 17 CPCB-attributed feeds form two groups: 11 feeds showed the same value in 12 of 13 overnight readings (18:30 Sun-06:30 Mon IST) and 5 feeds in 13 of 13 (whole capture: 37/46 and 41/47); the 17th feed has a different series; Anand Vihar DPCC 1,380 vs CPCB-attributed 178 at 23:30 IST Sun

cpcb_groups_direct.note: groups are the connected components of a >=90% pairwise-agreement graph; the counts here are direct simultaneous agreement

evidence.source: IQAir station pages (https://www.iqair.com/air-quality/india/delhi/delhi/<slug>), 'Station from' attribution and History > Hourly US AQI+
evidence.interval_tz: hours by start, IST (UTC+5:30); Sun night = 18:30 Sun-06:30 Mon; captured 16:43-16:44 UTC 9 Nov
evidence.method: max/median per feed; groups from a >=90% pairwise-agreement graph, then direct simultaneous agreement within each group over the stated window
evidence.status: reproduced from retained re-capture; NOT checked against CPCB/DPCC records; cause of CPCB-feed similarity unresolved
